posts.description: You can either design yourself, or be the product of your values and desires. Either is fine as long as it’s honest. Error happened.

My fear: getting the chance to say the important things, and not being able to. But the best things I’ve ever said came out in gushes of raw thought, formed just enough to be understood. Formed, not formatted. Social media is a stage, and I have stage fright. Error happened.

posts.title: Design is a nice-to-have
posts.description: I am in a very weird place right now when it comes to design. I still very much appreciate the craft, if anything I think it's more important than ever. But when it comes to ingesting news and information about the craft of digital design and tools for creation, I just can't help but feel… […]
